Investment Trust PLC
Ceylon Guardian Investment Trust PLC is the holding company of the investment business
of the Carson Cumberbatch Group. The Company principally engages in the holding and
management of its own investment portfolio comprising multiple asset classes, with a
focus on long-term value creation and capital appreciation.
As at 31 March 2026, the Guardian Group held an investment portfolio valued at
